name: Zhenye de Qingchen Guixia SOE
source:
A fan-made sequel to [url=/v49008]Chanye's Home[/url], created with the permission of the original developer [url=/p23480]YauYuenTong[/url]. Playing the original game first is highly recommended.
Note: The writing style is very different from the original story.
translation:
粉丝制作的 [url=/v49008]Chanye's Home[/url] 续集，经原开发者 [url=/p23480]YauYuenTong[/url] 许可创建。强烈建议先玩原版游戏。
注：写作风格与原著有很大不同。
